subject: FinServe: request for tenant-scoped log hold, purge SLA and evidence
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finserve.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinServe Security <security@finserve.com>
Date: 2027-09-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: FinServe request: tenant-scoped log retention hold and evidence pack

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this — FinServe's security & compliance team has a deployment-specific ask tied to an upcoming audit. We need confirmation that Redwood can: 1) enact a tenant-scoped log retention extension for tenant ID finserve-prod-01, 2) produce an evidentiary packet proving deletion actions and retention controls (for SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ review), and 3) provide suggested contract language for a short-term SLA addendum.

Scope: only transaction metadata (non-PII) and service-level audit trails for inference calls. We require artifacts that include: sample audit export (CSV), documentation of retention policy and retention enforcement, proof-of-delete workflow (including file hashes or deletion job IDs), and a signed attestation on Redwood letterhead.

Deadline: we'd like the evidence packet within 10 business days; our go-live date is Nov 1 so earlier is better. I've attached our SIG questionnaire fragment that highlights the fields we will submit back to auditors (FinServe-SIG-questions.pdf).

Can you confirm feasibility and an estimated delivery timeline?

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Security Engineer | FinServe Bank
attachments: FinServe-SIG-questions.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finserve.com>
Date: 2027-09-29T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinServe request: tenant-scoped log retention hold and evidence pack

Alyssa — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can support a tenant-scoped retention extension and produce an evidence pack, but specifics determine effort and timeline. Summary of options and constraints below.

What Redwood typically provides (enterprise contract baseline):
- Ephemeral inference session logs: default TTL 30 days.
- Structured audit & admin logs (control plane): retained 365 days for Dedicated/Private customers; shorter for hosted tiers unless contracted.

Proposed path for finserve-prod-01:
1) Scoped exception: extend retention on the specified tenant's session logs to 180 days (configurable per-tenant) with restricted access and SIEM forwarding.
2) Compensating controls: KMS envelope-locked storage, role-based access, SIEM ingestion for near-term forensic needs.
3) Evidence pack deliverables: retention policy PDF, sample audit-export CSV (redacted), proof-of-delete playbook, signed attestation on Redwood letterhead.

Attachments I'll include for context: rdw_retention_policy.pdf (our policy excerpt) and a redacted sample-audit-export.csv. ETA: I can coordinate an evidence pack draft in ~7 business days after I loop in Security & Compliance.

Next steps: can you confirm exact object scope (only transaction metadata? include model prompt text? inference outputs?) and whether FinServe needs cryptographic proof (hashes) or a signed deletion certificate is sufficient?

Subject: Re: FinServe request: tenant-scoped log retention hold and evidence pack

Jordan — thanks for the quick reply. Confirm scope: transaction metadata only (timestamps, request ids, token counts, latency, model variant). Do NOT include prompts, responses, or any PII.

FinServe prefers cryptographic proof where possible (file hashes + deletion job IDs). If Redwood can provide hashes for exported CSVs and a signed deletion certificate with job IDs/time, that will satisfy our auditors.

Also: please include suggested contract/addendum language that references a 180-day retention carveout, mutual SLA for availability, and data segregation assurances.

We're available next Tuesday for a quick 30-min sync if that helps.

Regards,
Alyssa

Jordan / Priya — thanks, I've reviewed the request and we can produce the requested artifacts. Plan & deliverables below: 

Planned deliverables (ETA 5 business days):
- finserve_evidence_pack.zip (contains):
  - attestation_finserve.pdf (signed by Redwood Security)
  - audit-log-snip.csv (redacted sample, transaction metadata only)
  - delete-jobs.txt (job IDs + timestamps for previously run deletions)
  - proof-of-delete-manifest.json (manifest + SHA256 hashes for exported objects)
- A one-page retention addendum draft for Legal to convert to contract language (suggested term: 180-day tenant-scoped retention for transaction metadata; exclusions: prompts/responses/PII; compensating controls: dedicated KMS key, restricted RBAC, SIEM forwarding)

Notes / constraints:
- We cannot retain prompt/response content for this carveout per policy without explicit data-usage consent; customer confirmed they only want metadata.
- Cryptographic proof: we'll include SHA256 hashes for exported CSVs and deletion job IDs; we can also provide signed timestamped attestation.
- Ops impact: enabling the tenant-scoped retention will require a config change and temporary monitoring; estimated maintenance window: low-impact, no downtime.

I will assemble the pack and share a Drive link once ready. Legal PR number would be helpful to attach the addendum; Priya, can you shepherd that?

Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
